notes: Single-stage: parse a sha256sum-style catalog (hex + two-space + path with spaces), validate strictly (malformed, absolute, '..', file/dir conflicts), then materialize every leaf as a zero-byte file with implied directories, idempotently. Exercises C-5c0f5e7a (create zero-byte files for all leaf entries in the listing) at medium via strict pre-validation and truncate-to-zero semantics; hidden cases cover deep nesting, duplicates, comments-only catalogs, and four fatal refusals where nothing may be written. Small nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth, adversarial_inputs, hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (exact leaf-set equality incl. size 0).
